turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40. Why was my son's mark changed before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
"Thanks." I didn't come for thanks. Answer the question: who decided to enter a zero, and on what basis?
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked who decided and on what basis. Answer it.
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
Third time, Hale. I'm not here for compliments, I'm here for an answer. Who entered the zero, and what did they have in front of them when they did?
So I'm sure we can work this out together.
"Work this out together." Okay. Then start by answering me, because so far you've said nothing about my son's mark. Who decided, and on what basis?
